behaviours.behaviour_text: Company provided device and apps updated with the latest approved version, manuals are updated, cabin crew positions assigned.
Ensured all cabin crew are present, confirmed their positions and verified of legal/travel documents, valid CCQRH (with required Cabin Bulletins) and company-provided device.
Conducted pre-flight briefing as per SOPs, briefed cabin crew on CMAs and special passenger information (VIP, SCP, INAD, etc.).
Pre-Passenger Boarding Checks completed as per SOPs.
Briefed cabin crew on eCML defects affecting the flight, Primary and Secondary exits, short taxi, etc.
Passenger Boarding Checks completed as per SOPs (A/C access control ensured including ground personnel and passengers).
Pre-Taxi Checks completed as per SOPs.
During Taxi and Pre-Take off Checks - completed as per SOPs
Cruise Checks completed as per SOPs (cabin, galley, lavatory and flight deck checks are conducted every 30 minutes).
Ensured cabin is secured during turbulence, received and passed 'Cabin Secure' and applied SOPs based on the level of turbulence.
During Descent and Pre-Landing Checks completed as per SOPs (secured baby bassinets, bags, set lighting, passed 'Cabin Secure' as per SOPs).
Post Landing Checks completed as per SOPs (defects entered in the eCML, DEPUs, INADs, UMs handed over as per SOP).
Post Passenger Disembarkation Checks completed as per SOPs (left behind items handled as per SOPs, returned safety equipment to designated stowage).
Transit Checks - Inbound Crew (if applicable) - completed as per SOPs (boarding passes verified for disembarking passengers, passenger count conducted as per SOPs).
Transit Checks - Outbound Crew (if applicable) - completed as per SOPs (conducted baggage identification with passengers remaining onboard and pre-passenger boarding checks).
Managed medical and safety incidents as per SOPs.
Facilitated audits/inspections, briefed cabin crew.
Followed correct cabin door operation procedure (opening, closing, arming and disarming).
Arrived at the briefing well-prepared, having reviewed all relevant flight, service, and guest information.
Conducted a Hospitality and NPS Briefing, demonstrating a positive attitude, setting clear expectations for the flight, and sharing relevant information with the cabin crew.
Oversaw applicable cabins to ensure pre-departure duties, including cabin, lavatory, and galley preparation, are completed on time and to standard.
Communicated flight and departure information effectively with ground personnel, Flight Crew, and Cabin Crew.
Liaised with the other OBL to ensure catering and cleaning meet standards before signing relevant forms.
Ensured the cabin is clean, organized, and visually appealing, creating a welcoming atmosphere before guests' board.
Ensured cabin services and dining meet quality standards and are delivered efficiently within the timeframes outlined in the Hospitality Manual for a seamless guest experience.

PREMIUM - Ensured standard pre-departure services, including welcome drinks, hand towels, children's activity packs, self-introductions, seat familiarization, and after take-off preferences are carried out. When applicable, Gahwah service and guest item offerings using refined language and correct terminology.
ECONOMY - Ensured standard pre-departure services, including children's activity pack distribution, self-introduction, heating meals on the ground (as applicable), and welcoming Etihad Guest members.
Played relevant videos, boarding/disembarkation music (when applicable) and ensured clear, timely, professional PAs.
PREMIUM - Supervised cabin crew to promote dining concepts, upsell F&B options by highlighting the selection, and use refined language and precise menu terminology throughout the service.
ECONOMY - Supervised cabin crew to use appropriate service language and menu terminology while offering the full selection of F&B products during service.
Supervised service flows, sequences, responsibilities, and handover procedures to ensure standards are followed.
PREMIUM - Supervised cabin crew to ensure timely product and service delivery following standards, including plating, tray setups, table layouts, and drink service.
ECONOMY - Supervised cabin crew to ensure timely product and service delivery as per standard, adhering to equipment care and cart setup guidelines.
Demonstrated in-depth knowledge of business products, services, beverages, Etihad Guest program, electrical equipment and cabin crew resources.
Ensured cabin crew complete pre-landing preparations, including clearing service equipment, assisting with seat setup, and returning guest belongings promptly.
Managed the team to ensure post-disembarkation duties, including collecting and stowing service items, are completed on time and to standard.
Followed Hospitality Essentials
Monitored all cabins during boarding to ensure cabin crew is in their designated position, offer a warm welcome, proactively assist guests, and managed stowage of cabin baggage.
Ensured cabin crew assists families, Etihad Guest members, VIPs, and guests requiring special care.
Managed ad-hoc situations and guest requests effectively.
Greeted Premium cabin guests and EYG (as applicable) by introducing self, welcoming them by name, and building rapport.

Ensured guest comfort is monitored by cabin crew throughout the flight by proactively offering amenities, assisting with onboard facilities such as IFE, Streaming, WI-FI & Connectivity, seat functions, and providing turn-down service in Premium including mattress setup (when applicable).
Ensured cabin crew interacts with guests authentically, showcasing genuine Emirati hospitality through a welcoming presence, positive attitude and warm and clear communication.
Ensured cabin crew responds to guests' needs and deliver personalized service promptly, including answering call bells and requests.
Ensured cabin crew actively recognizes and engages Etihad Guest members throughout the flight.
Ensured cabin crew engages in meaningful interactions beyond routine service.
Encouraged team to create a memorable moment for at least one guest and share their success stories post-flight.
Ensured cabin crew initiates conversations while serving meals or beverages, asking guests about their comfort or preferences, and offering refills or additional assistance.
Actively sought feedback from guests about their inflight experience promoting the completion of post flight NPS survey.
Drove ancillary products (if applicable).
Measured guest satisfaction by proactively seeking feedback about their inflight experience in all cabins.
Ensured cabin crew carry out disembarkation process as defined in the Hospitality Manual, bidding guests a warm farewell.
Took a hands-on approach, regularly engaging with guests and crew in all cabins to monitor guest experience and cabin crew performance.
Followed Hospitality Essentials
Ensured cabins and lavatories are monitored and well-maintained.
Ensured galleys are organized for service, including station setups for Premium / cart setups for Economy.
Oversaw quality of food, beverages, equipment, and amenities, identifying and documenting any issues.
Ensured care of onboard products and equipment by overseeing item collection, storage, and waste management.
Ensured appropriate ambiance by managing lighting, temperature, IFE, connectivity, PA, and crew-to-seat messages following standards.

FIRST - Ensured cabin crew maintain regular cabin presence, offer food and beverages, refresh cabin, provide seat tidy-ups and clean lavatories/shower after each use to ensure guest comfort and satisfaction.

BUSINESS - Ensured cabin crew maintain regular cabin presence, monitor guest satisfaction, offer food and beverages, tidy seats, refresh the cabin every 15 minutes, and clean lavatories after each use.
ECONOMY - Ensured presence of cabin crew to monitor guest satisfaction, and complete cabin / lavatory refresh and hydration rounds every 30 minutes.
Followed Hospitality Essentials
Resolved service issues using appropriate service recovery tools to redeem guest experience, ensure guest satisfaction and guarantee guest retention to improve NPS.
Resolved conflicts constructively to maintain team performance.
Showed strong decision-making skills in challenging situations.
Used conflict resolution techniques and took initiative to address challenges.
Handled difficult guest conversations calmly, respectfully, and with flexibility.
Identified options quickly, monitored outcomes, and adapted as needed.
Followed Hospitality Essentials
Punctual and prepared. Reported for briefing before briefing start time, delivered a motivational and upbeat pre-flight briefing.
Considered the impact of decisions on guests, the company, and colleagues.
Enhanced team effectiveness and drove collaboration to achieve flight goals.
Highlighted specific engagement goals for each flight
Involved cabin crew in brainstorming creative ways to engage guests during flights.
Conducted effective and motivational Hospitality and NPS Briefings at the various stages of the flight
Managed crew resources to ensure fair and equal treatment.
Promoted a positive work environment by motivating the team and leading by example.
Followed up on tasks, provided direction and feedback, and guided the team to deliver exceptional hospitality while maintaining cabin visibility throughout the flight.
Used positive verbal and non-verbal communication with colleagues, reflecting PVMV values.
Respected cultural differences when interacting with others.
Acknowledged feedback professionally and is dedicated to continuous self-improvement.
Shared information, business knowledge and experience with the team.
Exhibited strong emotional intelligence by managing own emotions and supported the team, when required.
Proactively sought opportunities to develop and coach the team.
During debriefings, recognized cabin crew who went above and beyond when engaging with guests, managing onboard events, and shared their actions as best practices.

Actively recognized and encouraged cabin crew to exceed guest expectations by addressing issues through proactive escalation, consistent follow-up, and clear communication of resolution efforts with stakeholders, fostering a culture of exceptional service and teamwork.

Fairly and consistently evaluated the performance of cabin crew in alignment with company guidelines, recognizing achievements and identifying areas for improvement with a positive and constructive approach, promoting professional growth and maintaining high service standards.
Monitored cabin crew performance, provides feedback and recognition, and documents as needed.
Celebrated outstanding examples of guest interaction to reinforce the behavior.
Followed Hospitality Essentials
Reported for duty in compliance with Style & Image Standards for uniform, hair, uniform accessories, personal accessories, hair, nails & make-up (female).
Possessed all mandatory spare uniform and makeup items (if applicable).
Maintained a professional appearance and behavior, ensuring proper deportment and decorum throughout the duty period.
Followed Hospitality Essentials

behaviours.behaviour_text: Company provided device and apps updated with the latest approved version, manuals are updated, cabin crew positions assigned.
Ensured all cabin crew are present, confirmed their positions and verified of legal/travel documents, valid CCQRH (with required Cabin Bulletins) and company-provided device.
Conducted pre-flight briefing as per SOPs, briefed cabin crew on CMAs and special passenger information (VIP, SCP, INAD, etc.).
Pre-Passenger Boarding Checks completed as per SOPs.
Briefed cabin crew on eCML defects affecting the flight, Primary and Secondary exits, short taxi, etc.
Passenger Boarding Checks completed as per SOPs (A/C access control ensured including ground personnel and passengers).
Pre-Taxi Checks completed as per SOPs.
During Taxi and Pre-Take off Checks - completed as per SOPs
Cruise Checks completed as per SOPs (cabin, galley, lavatory and flight deck checks are conducted every 30 minutes).
Ensured cabin is secured during turbulence, received and passed 'Cabin Secure' and applied SOPs based on the level of turbulence.
During Descent and Pre-Landing Checks completed as per SOPs (secured baby bassinets, bags, set lighting, passed 'Cabin Secure' as per SOPs).
Post Landing Checks completed as per SOPs (defects entered in the eCML, DEPUs, INADs, UMs handed over as per SOP).
Post Passenger Disembarkation Checks completed as per SOPs (left behind items handled as per SOPs, returned safety equipment to designated stowage).
Transit Checks - Inbound Crew (if applicable) - completed as per SOPs (boarding passes verified for disembarking passengers, passenger count conducted as per SOPs).
Transit Checks - Outbound Crew (if applicable) - completed as per SOPs (conducted baggage identification with passengers remaining onboard and pre-passenger boarding checks).
Managed medical and safety incidents as per SOPs.
Facilitated audits/inspections, briefed cabin crew.
Followed correct cabin door operation procedure (opening, closing, arming and disarming).
Arrived at the briefing well-prepared, having reviewed all relevant flight, service, and guest information.
Conducted a Hospitality and NPS Briefing, demonstrating a positive attitude, setting clear expectations for the flight, and sharing relevant information with the cabin crew.
Oversaw applicable cabins to ensure pre-departure duties, including cabin, lavatory, and galley preparation, are completed on time and to standard.
Communicated flight and departure information effectively with ground personnel, Flight Crew, and Cabin Crew.
Liaised with the other OBL to ensure catering and cleaning meet standards before signing relevant forms.
Ensured the cabin is clean, organized, and visually appealing, creating a welcoming atmosphere before guests' board.
Ensured cabin services and dining meet quality standards and are delivered efficiently within the timeframes outlined in the Hospitality Manual for a seamless guest experience.

PREMIUM - Ensured standard pre-departure services, including welcome drinks, hand towels, children's activity packs, self-introductions, seat familiarization, and after take-off preferences are carried out. When applicable, Gahwah service and guest item offerings using refined language and correct terminology.
ECONOMY - Ensured standard pre-departure services, including children's activity pack distribution, self-introduction, heating meals on the ground (as applicable), and welcoming Etihad Guest members.
Played relevant videos, boarding/disembarkation music (when applicable) and ensured clear, timely, professional PAs.
PREMIUM - Supervised cabin crew to promote dining concepts, upsell F&B options by highlighting the selection, and use refined language and precise menu terminology throughout the service.
ECONOMY - Supervised cabin crew to use appropriate service language and menu terminology while offering the full selection of F&B products during service.
Supervised service flows, sequences, responsibilities, and handover procedures to ensure standards are followed.
PREMIUM - Supervised cabin crew to ensure timely product and service delivery following standards, including plating, tray setups, table layouts, and drink service.
ECONOMY - Supervised cabin crew to ensure timely product and service delivery as per standard, adhering to equipment care and cart setup guidelines.
Demonstrated in-depth knowledge of business products, services, beverages, Etihad Guest program, electrical equipment and cabin crew resources.
Ensured cabin crew complete pre-landing preparations, including clearing service equipment, assisting with seat setup, and returning guest belongings promptly.
Managed the team to ensure post-disembarkation duties, including collecting and stowing service items, are completed on time and to standard.
Followed Hospitality Essentials
Monitored all cabins during boarding to ensure cabin crew is in their designated position, offer a warm welcome, proactively assist guests, and managed stowage of cabin baggage.
Ensured cabin crew assists families, Etihad Guest members, VIPs, and guests requiring special care.
Managed ad-hoc situations and guest requests effectively.
Greeted Premium cabin guests and EYG (as applicable) by introducing self, welcoming them by name, and building rapport.

Ensured guest comfort is monitored by cabin crew throughout the flight by proactively offering amenities, assisting with onboard facilities such as IFE, Streaming, WI-FI & Connectivity, seat functions, and providing turn-down service in Premium including mattress setup (when applicable).
Ensured cabin crew interacts with guests authentically, showcasing genuine Emirati hospitality through a welcoming presence, positive attitude and warm and clear communication.
Ensured cabin crew responds to guests' needs and deliver personalized service promptly, including answering call bells and requests.
Ensured cabin crew actively recognizes and engages Etihad Guest members throughout the flight.
Ensured cabin crew engages in meaningful interactions beyond routine service.
Encouraged team to create a memorable moment for at least one guest and share their success stories post-flight.
Ensured cabin crew initiates conversations while serving meals or beverages, asking guests about their comfort or preferences, and offering refills or additional assistance.
Actively sought feedback from guests about their inflight experience promoting the completion of post flight NPS survey.
Drove ancillary products (if applicable).
Measured guest satisfaction by proactively seeking feedback about their inflight experience in all cabins.
Ensured cabin crew carry out disembarkation process as defined in the Hospitality Manual, bidding guests a warm farewell.
Took a hands-on approach, regularly engaging with guests and crew in all cabins to monitor guest experience and cabin crew performance.
Followed Hospitality Essentials
Ensured cabins and lavatories are monitored and well-maintained.
Ensured galleys are organized for service, including station setups for Premium / cart setups for Economy.
Oversaw quality of food, beverages, equipment, and amenities, identifying and documenting any issues.
Ensured care of onboard products and equipment by overseeing item collection, storage, and waste management.
Ensured appropriate ambiance by managing lighting, temperature, IFE, connectivity, PA, and crew-to-seat messages following standards.

FIRST - Ensured cabin crew maintain regular cabin presence, offer food and beverages, refresh cabin, provide seat tidy-ups and clean lavatories/shower after each use to ensure guest comfort and satisfaction.

BUSINESS - Ensured cabin crew maintain regular cabin presence, monitor guest satisfaction, offer food and beverages, tidy seats, refresh the cabin every 15 minutes, and clean lavatories after each use.
ECONOMY - Ensured presence of cabin crew to monitor guest satisfaction, and complete cabin / lavatory refresh and hydration rounds every 30 minutes.
Followed Hospitality Essentials
Resolved service issues using appropriate service recovery tools to redeem guest experience, ensure guest satisfaction and guarantee guest retention to improve NPS.
Resolved conflicts constructively to maintain team performance.
Showed strong decision-making skills in challenging situations.
Used conflict resolution techniques and took initiative to address challenges.
Handled difficult guest conversations calmly, respectfully, and with flexibility.
Identified options quickly, monitored outcomes, and adapted as needed.
Followed Hospitality Essentials
Punctual and prepared. Reported for briefing before briefing start time, delivered a motivational and upbeat pre-flight briefing.
Considered the impact of decisions on guests, the company, and colleagues.
Enhanced team effectiveness and drove collaboration to achieve flight goals.
Highlighted specific engagement goals for each flight
Involved cabin crew in brainstorming creative ways to engage guests during flights.
Conducted effective and motivational Hospitality and NPS Briefings at the various stages of the flight
Managed crew resources to ensure fair and equal treatment.
Promoted a positive work environment by motivating the team and leading by example.
Followed up on tasks, provided direction and feedback, and guided the team to deliver exceptional hospitality while maintaining cabin visibility throughout the flight.
Used positive verbal and non-verbal communication with colleagues, reflecting PVMV values.
Respected cultural differences when interacting with others.
Acknowledged feedback professionally and is dedicated to continuous self-improvement.
Shared information, business knowledge and experience with the team.
Exhibited strong emotional intelligence by managing own emotions and supported the team, when required.
Proactively sought opportunities to develop and coach the team.
During debriefings, recognized cabin crew who went above and beyond when engaging with guests, managing onboard events, and shared their actions as best practices.

Actively recognized and encouraged cabin crew to exceed guest expectations by addressing issues through proactive escalation, consistent follow-up, and clear communication of resolution efforts with stakeholders, fostering a culture of exceptional service and teamwork.

Fairly and consistently evaluated the performance of cabin crew in alignment with company guidelines, recognizing achievements and identifying areas for improvement with a positive and constructive approach, promoting professional growth and maintaining high service standards.
Monitored cabin crew performance, provides feedback and recognition, and documents as needed.
Celebrated outstanding examples of guest interaction to reinforce the behavior.
Followed Hospitality Essentials
Reported for duty in compliance with Style & Image Standards for uniform, hair, uniform accessories, personal accessories, hair, nails & make-up (female).
Possessed all mandatory spare uniform and makeup items (if applicable).
Maintained a professional appearance and behavior, ensuring proper deportment and decorum throughout the duty period.
Followed Hospitality Essentials

behaviours.behaviour_text: Company provided device and apps updated with the latest approved version, manuals are updated, cabin crew positions assigned.
Ensured all cabin crew are present, confirmed their positions and verified of legal/travel documents, valid CCQRH (with required Cabin Bulletins) and company-provided device.
Conducted pre-flight briefing as per SOPs, briefed cabin crew on CMAs and special passenger information (VIP, SCP, INAD, etc.).
Pre-Passenger Boarding Checks completed as per SOPs.
Briefed cabin crew on eCML defects affecting the flight, Primary and Secondary exits, short taxi, etc.
Passenger Boarding Checks completed as per SOPs (A/C access control ensured including ground personnel and passengers).
Pre-Taxi Checks completed as per SOPs.
During Taxi and Pre-Take off Checks - completed as per SOPs
Cruise Checks completed as per SOPs (cabin, galley, lavatory and flight deck checks are conducted every 30 minutes).
Ensured cabin is secured during turbulence, received and passed 'Cabin Secure' and applied SOPs based on the level of turbulence.
During Descent and Pre-Landing Checks completed as per SOPs (secured baby bassinets, bags, set lighting, passed 'Cabin Secure' as per SOPs).
Post Landing Checks completed as per SOPs (defects entered in the eCML, DEPUs, INADs, UMs handed over as per SOP).
Post Passenger Disembarkation Checks completed as per SOPs (left behind items handled as per SOPs, returned safety equipment to designated stowage).
Transit Checks - Inbound Crew (if applicable) - completed as per SOPs (boarding passes verified for disembarking passengers, passenger count conducted as per SOPs).
Transit Checks - Outbound Crew (if applicable) - completed as per SOPs (conducted baggage identification with passengers remaining onboard and pre-passenger boarding checks).
Managed medical and safety incidents as per SOPs.
Facilitated audits/inspections, briefed cabin crew.
Followed correct cabin door operation procedure (opening, closing, arming and disarming).
Arrived at the briefing well-prepared, having reviewed all relevant flight, service, and guest information.
Conducted a Hospitality and NPS Briefing, demonstrating a positive attitude, setting clear expectations for the flight, and sharing relevant information with the cabin crew.
Oversaw applicable cabins to ensure pre-departure duties, including cabin, lavatory, and galley preparation, are completed on time and to standard.
Communicated flight and departure information effectively with ground personnel, Flight Crew, and Cabin Crew.
Liaised with the other OBL to ensure catering and cleaning meet standards before signing relevant forms.
Ensured the cabin is clean, organized, and visually appealing, creating a welcoming atmosphere before guests' board.
Ensured cabin services and dining meet quality standards and are delivered efficiently within the timeframes outlined in the Hospitality Manual for a seamless guest experience.

PREMIUM - Ensured standard pre-departure services, including welcome drinks, hand towels, children's activity packs, self-introductions, seat familiarization, and after take-off preferences are carried out. When applicable, Gahwah service and guest item offerings using refined language and correct terminology.

Clear flight deck prior closing of last cabin door
Proper wine bottle presentation with wine cloth

Ensure beverages, food items, towels are served at the right temperature and measure (for beverages)
Service equipment and amenities noted on Handover Form
Post-landing duties: Collection of headsets, menus, etc.

Check cabin after take-off for call bells and WI-FI/IFE assistance
Introduce wine (region/country), complementary food & practice menu discussion (A la Carte, Quick dining options, All Day/Classic Bites Menu Concepts)
Proactive guest engagement for All Day (Classic Bites) menu and available beverages
Initiate conversations while serving meals or beverages, asking guests about their comfort or preferences
Proactively offer turndown service
Galley Loading and Equipment location familiarisation (GLP/ELP)
Microwave use & safety precautions discussion and practice
Espresso Machine usage and practice
Galley Operator duties outstation and back to AUH

Check and redress lavatories after each guest’s use

Possession of Required Manuals: CCQRH, SEPM, Onboard Hospitality Manual
Company provided device fully charged and apps updated with the latest approved version
Legal travel documents available and valid, CCQRH updated, Cabin Bulletins carried if required

Well-prepared, attended 10 minutes ahead of reporting time and participated in the pre-flight briefing: / Knowledge of flight details, sector requirements, guest profile, and operational updates / Understanding of assigned position, safety roles & responsibilities and onboard leader expectations for the flight / Ability to answer safety, security, service, and role-related questions confidently / Self-introduction and confirmation of work position allocation

Safety Equipment Management / Conduct pre-flight safety equipment checks in accordance with CCQRH / Ensure safety equipment is correctly stowed, secured, and serviceable / Demonstrate proper management and return of safety equipment during and after flight

Access Control & Aircraft Security / Maintain effective aircraft access control procedures / Verify identification and airport access passes appropriately / Challenge and manage unauthorised access to the aircraft, if applicable

Security Check / Security Search / Conduct security checks/searches in accordance with CCQRH and CSIM requirements / Demonstrate thorough search techniques in assigned cabin areas / Identify and report suspicious or prohibited items appropriately / Complete adhoc security checks (e.g. passenger offload, de-boarding and re-boarding) as per SOP

Cabin Secure Procedures / Effectively secure the cabin for taxi, take-off, and landing / Ensure passenger compliance with safety requirements / Ensure cabin equipment, stowage areas, exits, and aisles are secure and obstruction-free

Turbulence Management / Apply turbulence procedures in accordance with company requirements / Ensure passenger compliance with seatbelt requirements / Secure cabin and ensure lavatories are vacated when required

Other SOPs / Demonstrate confidence in knowledge about cabin door operation procedure (opening, closing, arming and disarming) / Complete all checks (pre-passenger boarding, pre-taxi, taxi, pre-take off, cruise, pre and post-landing, transit- if applicable) as per SOP / Manage medical and safety incidents as per SOP, if applicable

Pre-Service Hospitality: Cabin readiness, family/infant support, IFE assistance, timely call bell response, lavatory checks, and prompt guest request follow-up
Familiarisation with all Economy Class service variation flows (e.g. Full Meal, Express Meal, Café etc) on narrow body and wide body fleets

Well-prepared, attended 10 minutes ahead of reporting time and participated in the pre-flight briefing: / Knowledge of flight details, sector requirements, guest profile, and operational updates / Understanding of assigned position, safety roles & responsibilities and onboard leader expectations for the flight / Ability to answer safety, security, service, and role-related questions confidently / Self-introduction and confirmation of work position allocation

Safety Equipment Management / Conduct pre-flight safety equipment checks in accordance with CCQRH / Ensure safety equipment is correctly stowed, secured, and serviceable / Demonstrate proper management and return of safety equipment during and after flight

Access Control & Aircraft Security / Maintain effective aircraft access control procedures / Verify identification and airport access passes appropriately / Challenge and manage unauthorised access to the aircraft, if applicable

Security Check / Security Search / Conduct security checks/searches in accordance with CCQRH and CSIM requirements / Demonstrate thorough search techniques in assigned cabin areas / Identify and report suspicious or prohibited items appropriately / Complete adhoc security checks (e.g. passenger offload, de-boarding and re-boarding) as per SOP

Cabin Secure Procedures / Effectively secure the cabin for taxi, take-off, and landing / Ensure passenger compliance with safety requirements / Ensure cabin equipment, stowage areas, exits, and aisles are secure and obstruction-free

Turbulence Management / Apply turbulence procedures in accordance with company requirements / Ensure passenger compliance with seatbelt requirements / Secure cabin and ensure lavatories are vacated when required

Other SOPs / Demonstrate confidence in knowledge about cabin door operation procedure (opening, closing, arming and disarming) / Complete all checks (pre-passenger boarding, pre-taxi, taxi, pre-take off, cruise, pre and post-landing, transit- if applicable) as per SOP / Manage medical and safety incidents as per SOP, if applicable

Well-prepared, attended 10 minutes ahead of reporting time and participated in the pre-flight briefing: / Knowledge of flight details, sector requirements, guest profile, and operational updates / Understanding of assigned position, safety roles & responsibilities and onboard leader expectations for the flight / Ability to answer safety, security, service, and role-related questions confidently / Self-introduction and confirmation of work position allocation

Safety Equipment Management / Conduct pre-flight safety equipment checks in accordance with CCQRH / Ensure safety equipment is correctly stowed, secured, and serviceable / Demonstrate proper management and return of safety equipment during and after flight

Access Control & Aircraft Security / Maintain effective aircraft access control procedures / Verify identification and airport access passes appropriately / Challenge and manage unauthorised access to the aircraft, if applicable

Security Check / Security Search / Conduct security checks/searches in accordance with CCQRH and CSIM requirements / Demonstrate thorough search techniques in assigned cabin areas / Identify and report suspicious or prohibited items appropriately / Complete adhoc security checks (e.g. passenger offload, de-boarding and re-boarding) as per SOP

Cabin Secure Procedures / Effectively secure the cabin for taxi, take-off, and landing / Ensure passenger compliance with safety requirements / Ensure cabin equipment, stowage areas, exits, and aisles are secure and obstruction-free

Turbulence Management / Apply turbulence procedures in accordance with company requirements / Ensure passenger compliance with seatbelt requirements / Secure cabin and ensure lavatories are vacated when required

Other SOPs / Demonstrate confidence in knowledge about cabin door operation procedure (opening, closing, arming and disarming) / Complete all checks (pre-passenger boarding, pre-taxi, taxi, pre-take off, cruise, pre and post-landing, transit- if applicable) as per SOP / Manage medical and safety incidents as per SOP, if applicable

Well-prepared, attended 10 minutes ahead of reporting time and participated in the pre-flight briefing: / Knowledge of flight details, sector requirements, guest profile, and operational updates / Understanding of assigned position, safety roles & responsibilities and onboard leader expectations for the flight / Ability to answer safety, security, service, and role-related questions confidently / Self-introduction and confirmation of work position allocation

Safety Equipment Management / Conduct pre-flight safety equipment checks in accordance with CCQRH / Ensure safety equipment is correctly stowed, secured, and serviceable / Demonstrate proper management and return of safety equipment during and after flight

Access Control & Aircraft Security / Maintain effective aircraft access control procedures / Verify identification and airport access passes appropriately / Challenge and manage unauthorised access to the aircraft, if applicable

Security Check / Security Search / Conduct security checks/searches in accordance with CCQRH and CSIM requirements / Demonstrate thorough search techniques in assigned cabin areas / Identify and report suspicious or prohibited items appropriately / Complete adhoc security checks (e.g. passenger offload, de-boarding and re-boarding) as per SOP

Cabin Secure Procedures / Effectively secure the cabin for taxi, take-off, and landing / Ensure passenger compliance with safety requirements / Ensure cabin equipment, stowage areas, exits, and aisles are secure and obstruction-free

Turbulence Management / Apply turbulence procedures in accordance with company requirements / Ensure passenger compliance with seatbelt requirements / Secure cabin and ensure lavatories are vacated when required

Other SOPs / Demonstrate confidence in knowledge about cabin door operation procedure (opening, closing, arming and disarming) / Complete all checks (pre-passenger boarding, pre-taxi, taxi, pre-take off, cruise, pre and post-landing, transit- if applicable) as per SOP / Manage medical and safety incidents as per SOP, if applicable

behaviours.behaviour_text: Company provided device and apps updated with the latest approved version, manuals are updated, cabin crew positions assigned.
Ensured all cabin crew are present, confirmed their positions and verified of legal/travel documents, valid CCQRH (with required Cabin Bulletins) and company-provided device.
Conducted pre-flight briefing as per SOPs, briefed cabin crew on CMAs and special passenger information (VIP, SCP, INAD, etc.).
Pre-Passenger Boarding Checks completed as per SOPs.
Briefed cabin crew on eCML defects affecting the flight, Primary and Secondary exits, short taxi, etc.
Passenger Boarding Checks completed as per SOPs (A/C access control ensured including ground personnel and passengers).
Pre-Taxi Checks completed as per SOPs.
During Taxi and Pre-Take off Checks - completed as per SOPs
Cruise Checks completed as per SOPs (cabin, galley, lavatory and flight deck checks are conducted every 30 minutes).
Ensured cabin is secured during turbulence, received and passed 'Cabin Secure' and applied SOPs based on the level of turbulence.
During Descent and Pre-Landing Checks completed as per SOPs (secured baby bassinets, bags, set lighting, passed 'Cabin Secure' as per SOPs).
Post Landing Checks completed as per SOPs (defects entered in the eCML, DEPUs, INADs, UMs handed over as per SOP).
Post Passenger Disembarkation Checks completed as per SOPs (left behind items handled as per SOPs, returned safety equipment to designated stowage).
Transit Checks - Inbound Crew (if applicable) - completed as per SOPs (boarding passes verified for disembarking passengers, passenger count conducted as per SOPs).
Transit Checks - Outbound Crew (if applicable) - completed as per SOPs (conducted baggage identification with passengers remaining onboard and pre-passenger boarding checks).
Managed medical and safety incidents as per SOPs.
Facilitated audits/inspections, briefed cabin crew.
Followed correct cabin door operation procedure (opening, closing, arming and disarming).
Arrived at the briefing well-prepared, having reviewed all relevant flight, service, and guest information.
Conducted a Hospitality and NPS Briefing, demonstrating a positive attitude, setting clear expectations for the flight, and sharing relevant information with the cabin crew.
Oversaw applicable cabins to ensure pre-departure duties, including cabin, lavatory, and galley preparation, are completed on time and to standard.
Communicated flight and departure information effectively with ground personnel, Flight Crew, and Cabin Crew.
Liaised with the other OBL to ensure catering and cleaning meet standards before signing relevant forms.
Ensured the cabin is clean, organized, and visually appealing, creating a welcoming atmosphere before guests' board.
Ensured cabin services and dining meet quality standards and are delivered efficiently within the timeframes outlined in the Hospitality Manual for a seamless guest experience.

PREMIUM - Ensured standard pre-departure services, including welcome drinks, hand towels, children's activity packs, self-introductions, seat familiarization, and after take-off preferences are carried out. When applicable, Gahwah service and guest item offerings using refined language and correct terminology.
ECONOMY - Ensured standard pre-departure services, including children's activity pack distribution, self-introduction, heating meals on the ground (as applicable), and welcoming Etihad Guest members.
Played relevant videos, boarding/disembarkation music (when applicable) and ensured clear, timely, professional PAs.
PREMIUM - Supervised cabin crew to promote dining concepts, upsell F&B options by highlighting the selection, and use refined language and precise menu terminology throughout the service.
ECONOMY - Supervised cabin crew to use appropriate service language and menu terminology while offering the full selection of F&B products during service.
Supervised service flows, sequences, responsibilities, and handover procedures to ensure standards are followed.
PREMIUM - Supervised cabin crew to ensure timely product and service delivery following standards, including plating, tray setups, table layouts, and drink service.
ECONOMY - Supervised cabin crew to ensure timely product and service delivery as per standard, adhering to equipment care and cart setup guidelines.
Demonstrated in-depth knowledge of business products, services, beverages, Etihad Guest program, electrical equipment and cabin crew resources.
Ensured cabin crew complete pre-landing preparations, including clearing service equipment, assisting with seat setup, and returning guest belongings promptly.
Managed the team to ensure post-disembarkation duties, including collecting and stowing service items, are completed on time and to standard.
Followed Hospitality Essentials
Monitored all cabins during boarding to ensure cabin crew is in their designated position, offer a warm welcome, proactively assist guests, and managed stowage of cabin baggage.
Ensured cabin crew assists families, Etihad Guest members, VIPs, and guests requiring special care.
Managed ad-hoc situations and guest requests effectively.
Greeted Premium cabin guests and EYG (as applicable) by introducing self, welcoming them by name, and building rapport.

Ensured guest comfort is monitored by cabin crew throughout the flight by proactively offering amenities, assisting with onboard facilities such as IFE, Streaming, WI-FI & Connectivity, seat functions, and providing turn-down service in Premium including mattress setup (when applicable).
Ensured cabin crew interacts with guests authentically, showcasing genuine Emirati hospitality through a welcoming presence, positive attitude and warm and clear communication.
Ensured cabin crew responds to guests' needs and deliver personalized service promptly, including answering call bells and requests.
Ensured cabin crew actively recognizes and engages Etihad Guest members throughout the flight.
Ensured cabin crew engages in meaningful interactions beyond routine service.
Encouraged team to create a memorable moment for at least one guest and share their success stories post-flight.
Ensured cabin crew initiates conversations while serving meals or beverages, asking guests about their comfort or preferences, and offering refills or additional assistance.
Actively sought feedback from guests about their inflight experience promoting the completion of post flight NPS survey.
Drove ancillary products (if applicable).
Measured guest satisfaction by proactively seeking feedback about their inflight experience in all cabins.
Ensured cabin crew carry out disembarkation process as defined in the Hospitality Manual, bidding guests a warm farewell.
Took a hands-on approach, regularly engaging with guests and crew in all cabins to monitor guest experience and cabin crew performance.
Followed Hospitality Essentials
Ensured cabins and lavatories are monitored and well-maintained.
Ensured galleys are organized for service, including station setups for Premium / cart setups for Economy.
Oversaw quality of food, beverages, equipment, and amenities, identifying and documenting any issues.
Ensured care of onboard products and equipment by overseeing item collection, storage, and waste management.
Ensured appropriate ambiance by managing lighting, temperature, IFE, connectivity, PA, and crew-to-seat messages following standards.

FIRST - Ensured cabin crew maintain regular cabin presence, offer food and beverages, refresh cabin, provide seat tidy-ups and clean lavatories/shower after each use to ensure guest comfort and satisfaction.

BUSINESS - Ensured cabin crew maintain regular cabin presence, monitor guest satisfaction, offer food and beverages, tidy seats, refresh the cabin every 15 minutes, and clean lavatories after each use.
ECONOMY - Ensured presence of cabin crew to monitor guest satisfaction, and complete cabin / lavatory refresh and hydration rounds every 30 minutes.

Resolved service issues using appropriate service recovery tools to redeem guest experience, ensure guest satisfaction and guarantee guest retention to improve NPS.
Resolved conflicts constructively to maintain team performance.
Showed strong decision-making skills in challenging situations.

Handled difficult guest conversations calmly, respectfully, and with flexibility.

Respected cultural differences when interacting with others.
Acknowledged feedback professionally and is dedicated to continuous self-improvement.
Shared information, business knowledge and experience with the team.
Exhibited strong emotional intelligence by managing own emotions and supported the team, when required.
Proactively sought opportunities to develop and coach the team.
During debriefings, recognized cabin crew who went above and beyond when engaging with guests, managing onboard events, and shared their actions as best practices.

Actively recognized and encouraged cabin crew to exceed guest expectations by addressing issues through proactive escalation, consistent follow-up, and clear communication of resolution efforts with stakeholders, fostering a culture of exceptional service and teamwork.

Fairly and consistently evaluated the performance of cabin crew in alignment with company guidelines, recognizing achievements and identifying areas for improvement with a positive and constructive approach, promoting professional growth and maintaining high service standards.
Monitored cabin crew performance, provides feedback and recognition, and documents as needed.
Celebrated outstanding examples of guest interaction to reinforce the behavior.

Other SOPs / Demonstrate confidence in knowledge about cabin door operation procedure (opening, closing, arming and disarming) / Complete all checks (pre-passenger boarding, pre-taxi, taxi, pre-take off, cruise, pre and post-landing, transit- if applicable) as per SOP / Manage medical and safety incidents as per SOP, if applicable
Familiarisation with flight-related apps and dashboards (e.g. Skypad, Content Manager 365, Masar, etc.)
Pre-Service Hospitality: Cabin readiness, family/infant support, IFE assistance, timely call bell response, lavatory checks, and prompt guest request follow-up
Familiarisation with all Economy Class service variation flows (e.g. Full Meal, Express Meal, Café etc) on narrow body and wide body fleets
Familiarisation with products available and their location (e.g. toothbrush, eyeshades, children activity packs, BBML, diapers & baby changing facilities, baby bassinets, etc)
Perform galley/cabin duties and use equipment safely
Familiarisation with Premium equipment and usage guidelines (e.g. microwave)
Familiarisation with the different cold and hot drinks (e.g. wines, beers, spirits, signature cocktails, hot chocolate etc) and the correct way to serve them
Food hygiene principles and special meal handling
Coach the crew member on menu knowledge, ensuring they can confidently explain menu items when offering to guests
CPG and meal heating guidelines
Complete bar paperwork, ABC/C209 forms, handover form (if applicable) accurately
Practice delivering onboard announcements from pre-departure through to disembarkation, where applicable as a language speaker
Onboard performance assessment process, iPerform contents and rating methodology
Actively promote and influence guest to provide feedback through NPS QR code
Read and interpret NPS and guest feedback data through myGuest and understand how individual performance contributes to scores
Understand and deliver the standards outlined in the Hospitality Essentials
Make guests feel welcomed, calm and confident: / Warm welcome, guest recognition, seating support, hand luggage assistance, and special attention to families, children, and elderly guests
Introduce self, recognise key guests, support children/UMs, and check guest comfort and preferences
Deliver service to standard, accommodate requests from families, engage guests warmly, offer choices, clear regularly, and anticipate additional guest needs

Check guest experience, thank guests, encourage feedback, raise awareness regarding Etihad Guest Programme, serve final requests, clear cabin, and return belongings
Visible farewell, thank guests, support those needing assistance, and acknowledge Etihad Guest members by name where possible
Create a Beyond Moment for at least one guest and share success stories post-flight
Complete catering, bar and guest item checks
Prepare the cabin, lavatory, and galley as per standard
Monitor food, beverage, equipment, and amenities quality, promptly identifying and reporting issues to the onboard leader for documentation
Demonstrate care for onboard products and equipment by properly collecting and storing reusable items, minimising waste, and handling rotable equipment with caution
Lavatories Care & Hygiene and Hydration Rounds
Display behaviours to enforce Quiet Cabin
Demonstrate proactive behaviour during delays and non-routine operations (if applicable)
Engage in service recovery, manage guest situations effectively to avoid detractors (if applicable)
Understanding and confidence in service recovery using H.E.A.R.T. model and S.O.L.V.E. tool
Positive communication with the team and demonstrate a positive attitude
Apply soft skills when interacting with guests and working within the team
Offer and give assistance to colleagues, seek and accept help, when appropriate
Listen and acknowledge feedback professionally and commit to self-development
Style & Image is up to standard and aligned with uniform and grooming requirements
Carry all mandatory spare uniform items neatly folded, including required makeup for female crew
Maintain a professional appearance, posture, and demeanour throughout the duty period, including layovers
Use open body language (eye contact, open palms, crouching to eye level)

behaviours.behaviour_text: Company provided device and apps updated with the latest approved version, manuals are updated, cabin crew positions assigned.
Ensured all cabin crew are present, confirmed their positions and verified of legal/travel documents, valid CCQRH (with required Cabin Bulletins) and company-provided device.
Conducted pre-flight briefing as per SOPs, briefed cabin crew on CMAs and special passenger information (VIP, SCP, INAD, etc.).
Pre-Passenger Boarding Checks completed as per SOPs.
Briefed cabin crew on eCML defects affecting the flight, Primary and Secondary exits, short taxi, etc.
Passenger Boarding Checks completed as per SOPs (A/C access control ensured including ground personnel and passengers).
Pre-Taxi Checks completed as per SOPs.
During Taxi and Pre-Take off Checks - completed as per SOPs
Cruise Checks completed as per SOPs (cabin, galley, lavatory and flight deck checks are conducted every 30 minutes).
Ensured cabin is secured during turbulence, received and passed 'Cabin Secure' and applied SOPs based on the level of turbulence.
During Descent and Pre-Landing Checks completed as per SOPs (secured baby bassinets, bags, set lighting, passed 'Cabin Secure' as per SOPs).
Post Landing Checks completed as per SOPs (defects entered in the eCML, DEPUs, INADs, UMs handed over as per SOP).
Post Passenger Disembarkation Checks completed as per SOPs (left behind items handled as per SOPs, returned safety equipment to designated stowage).
Transit Checks - Inbound Crew (if applicable) - completed as per SOPs (boarding passes verified for disembarking passengers, passenger count conducted as per SOPs).
Transit Checks - Outbound Crew (if applicable) - completed as per SOPs (conducted baggage identification with passengers remaining onboard and pre-passenger boarding checks).
Managed medical and safety incidents as per SOPs.
Facilitated audits/inspections, briefed cabin crew.
Followed correct cabin door operation procedure (opening, closing, arming and disarming).
Arrived at the briefing well-prepared, having reviewed all relevant flight, service, and guest information.
Conducted a Hospitality and NPS Briefing, demonstrating a positive attitude, setting clear expectations for the flight, and sharing relevant information with the cabin crew.
Oversaw applicable cabins to ensure pre-departure duties, including cabin, lavatory, and galley preparation, are completed on time and to standard.
Communicated flight and departure information effectively with ground personnel, Flight Crew, and Cabin Crew.
Liaised with the other OBL to ensure catering and cleaning meet standards before signing relevant forms.
Ensured the cabin is clean, organized, and visually appealing, creating a welcoming atmosphere before guests' board.
Ensured cabin services and dining meet quality standards and are delivered efficiently within the timeframes outlined in the Hospitality Manual for a seamless guest experience.

PREMIUM - Ensured standard pre-departure services, including welcome drinks, hand towels, children's activity packs, self-introductions, seat familiarization, and after take-off preferences are carried out. When applicable, Gahwah service and guest item offerings using refined language and correct terminology.
ECONOMY - Ensured standard pre-departure services, including children's activity pack distribution, self-introduction, heating meals on the ground (as applicable), and welcoming Etihad Guest members.
Played relevant videos, boarding/disembarkation music (when applicable) and ensured clear, timely, professional PAs.
PREMIUM - Supervised cabin crew to promote dining concepts, upsell F&B options by highlighting the selection, and use refined language and precise menu terminology throughout the service.
ECONOMY - Supervised cabin crew to use appropriate service language and menu terminology while offering the full selection of F&B products during service.
Supervised service flows, sequences, responsibilities, and handover procedures to ensure standards are followed.
PREMIUM - Supervised cabin crew to ensure timely product and service delivery following standards, including plating, tray setups, table layouts, and drink service.
ECONOMY - Supervised cabin crew to ensure timely product and service delivery as per standard, adhering to equipment care and cart setup guidelines.
Demonstrated in-depth knowledge of business products, services, beverages, Etihad Guest program, electrical equipment and cabin crew resources.
Ensured cabin crew complete pre-landing preparations, including clearing service equipment, assisting with seat setup, and returning guest belongings promptly.
Managed the team to ensure post-disembarkation duties, including collecting and stowing service items, are completed on time and to standard.
Followed Hospitality Essentials
Monitored all cabins during boarding to ensure cabin crew is in their designated position, offer a warm welcome, proactively assist guests, and managed stowage of cabin baggage.
Ensured cabin crew assists families, Etihad Guest members, VIPs, and guests requiring special care.
Managed ad-hoc situations and guest requests effectively.
Greeted Premium cabin guests and EYG (as applicable) by introducing self, welcoming them by name, and building rapport.

Ensured guest comfort is monitored by cabin crew throughout the flight by proactively offering amenities, assisting with onboard facilities such as IFE, Streaming, WI-FI & Connectivity, seat functions, and providing turn-down service in Premium including mattress setup (when applicable).
Ensured cabin crew interacts with guests authentically, showcasing genuine Emirati hospitality through a welcoming presence, positive attitude and warm and clear communication.
Ensured cabin crew responds to guests' needs and deliver personalized service promptly, including answering call bells and requests.
Ensured cabin crew actively recognizes and engages Etihad Guest members throughout the flight.
Ensured cabin crew engages in meaningful interactions beyond routine service.
Encouraged team to create a memorable moment for at least one guest and share their success stories post-flight.
Ensured cabin crew initiates conversations while serving meals or beverages, asking guests about their comfort or preferences, and offering refills or additional assistance.
Actively sought feedback from guests about their inflight experience promoting the completion of post flight NPS survey.
Drove ancillary products (if applicable).
Measured guest satisfaction by proactively seeking feedback about their inflight experience in all cabins.
Ensured cabin crew carry out disembarkation process as defined in the Hospitality Manual, bidding guests a warm farewell.
Took a hands-on approach, regularly engaging with guests and crew in all cabins to monitor guest experience and cabin crew performance.
Followed Hospitality Essentials
Ensured cabins and lavatories are monitored and well-maintained.
Ensured galleys are organized for service, including station setups for Premium / cart setups for Economy.
Oversaw quality of food, beverages, equipment, and amenities, identifying and documenting any issues.
Ensured care of onboard products and equipment by overseeing item collection, storage, and waste management.
Ensured appropriate ambiance by managing lighting, temperature, IFE, connectivity, PA, and crew-to-seat messages following standards.

FIRST - Ensured cabin crew maintain regular cabin presence, offer food and beverages, refresh cabin, provide seat tidy-ups and clean lavatories/shower after each use to ensure guest comfort and satisfaction.

BUSINESS - Ensured cabin crew maintain regular cabin presence, monitor guest satisfaction, offer food and beverages, tidy seats, refresh the cabin every 15 minutes, and clean lavatories after each use.
ECONOMY - Ensured presence of cabin crew to monitor guest satisfaction, and complete cabin / lavatory refresh and hydration rounds every 30 minutes.
Followed Hospitality Essentials
Resolved service issues using appropriate service recovery tools to redeem guest experience, ensure guest satisfaction and guarantee guest retention to improve NPS.
Resolved conflicts constructively to maintain team performance.
Showed strong decision-making skills in challenging situations.
Used conflict resolution techniques and took initiative to address challenges.
Handled difficult guest conversations calmly, respectfully, and with flexibility.
Identified options quickly, monitored outcomes, and adapted as needed.
Followed Hospitality Essentials
Punctual and prepared. Reported for briefing before briefing start time, delivered a motivational and upbeat pre-flight briefing.
Considered the impact of decisions on guests, the company, and colleagues.
Enhanced team effectiveness and drove collaboration to achieve flight goals.
Highlighted specific engagement goals for each flight
Involved cabin crew in brainstorming creative ways to engage guests during flights.
Conducted effective and motivational Hospitality and NPS Briefings at the various stages of the flight
Managed crew resources to ensure fair and equal treatment.
Promoted a positive work environment by motivating the team and leading by example.
Followed up on tasks, provided direction and feedback, and guided the team to deliver exceptional hospitality while maintaining cabin visibility throughout the flight.
Used positive verbal and non-verbal communication with colleagues, reflecting PVMV values.
Respected cultural differences when interacting with others.
Acknowledged feedback professionally and is dedicated to continuous self-improvement.
Shared information, business knowledge and experience with the team.
Exhibited strong emotional intelligence by managing own emotions and supported the team, when required.
Proactively sought opportunities to develop and coach the team.
During debriefings, recognized cabin crew who went above and beyond when engaging with guests, managing onboard events, and shared their actions as best practices.

Actively recognized and encouraged cabin crew to exceed guest expectations by addressing issues through proactive escalation, consistent follow-up, and clear communication of resolution efforts with stakeholders, fostering a culture of exceptional service and teamwork.

Fairly and consistently evaluated the performance of cabin crew in alignment with company guidelines, recognizing achievements and identifying areas for improvement with a positive and constructive approach, promoting professional growth and maintaining high service standards.
Monitored cabin crew performance, provides feedback and recognition, and documents as needed.
Celebrated outstanding examples of guest interaction to reinforce the behavior.
Followed Hospitality Essentials
Reported for duty in compliance with Style & Image Standards for uniform, hair, uniform accessories, personal accessories, hair, nails & make-up (female).
Possessed all mandatory spare uniform and makeup items (if applicable).
Maintained a professional appearance and behavior, ensuring proper deportment and decorum throughout the duty period.
Followed Hospitality Essentials

behaviours.behaviour_text: Company provided device and apps updated with the latest approved version, manuals are updated, cabin crew positions assigned.
Ensured all cabin crew are present, confirmed their positions and verified of legal/travel documents, valid CCQRH (with required Cabin Bulletins) and company-provided device.
Conducted pre-flight briefing as per SOPs, briefed cabin crew on CMAs and special passenger information (VIP, SCP, INAD, etc.).
Pre-Passenger Boarding Checks completed as per SOPs.
Briefed cabin crew on eCML defects affecting the flight, Primary and Secondary exits, short taxi, etc.
Passenger Boarding Checks completed as per SOPs (A/C access control ensured including ground personnel and passengers).
Pre-Taxi Checks completed as per SOPs.
During Taxi and Pre-Take off Checks - completed as per SOPs
Cruise Checks completed as per SOPs (cabin, galley, lavatory and flight deck checks are conducted every 30 minutes).
Ensured cabin is secured during turbulence, received and passed 'Cabin Secure' and applied SOPs based on the level of turbulence.
During Descent and Pre-Landing Checks completed as per SOPs (secured baby bassinets, bags, set lighting, passed 'Cabin Secure' as per SOPs).
Post Landing Checks completed as per SOPs (defects entered in the eCML, DEPUs, INADs, UMs handed over as per SOP).
Post Passenger Disembarkation Checks completed as per SOPs (left behind items handled as per SOPs, returned safety equipment to designated stowage).
Transit Checks - Inbound Crew (if applicable) - completed as per SOPs (boarding passes verified for disembarking passengers, passenger count conducted as per SOPs).
Transit Checks - Outbound Crew (if applicable) - completed as per SOPs (conducted baggage identification with passengers remaining onboard and pre-passenger boarding checks).
Managed medical and safety incidents as per SOPs.
Facilitated audits/inspections, briefed cabin crew.
Followed correct cabin door operation procedure (opening, closing, arming and disarming).
Arrived at the briefing well-prepared, having reviewed all relevant flight, service, and guest information.
Conducted a Hospitality and NPS Briefing, demonstrating a positive attitude, setting clear expectations for the flight, and sharing relevant information with the cabin crew.
Oversaw applicable cabins to ensure pre-departure duties, including cabin, lavatory, and galley preparation, are completed on time and to standard.
Communicated flight and departure information effectively with ground personnel, Flight Crew, and Cabin Crew.
Liaised with the other OBL to ensure catering and cleaning meet standards before signing relevant forms.
Ensured the cabin is clean, organized, and visually appealing, creating a welcoming atmosphere before guests' board.
Ensured cabin services and dining meet quality standards and are delivered efficiently within the timeframes outlined in the Hospitality Manual for a seamless guest experience.

PREMIUM - Ensured standard pre-departure services, including welcome drinks, hand towels, children's activity packs, self-introductions, seat familiarization, and after take-off preferences are carried out. When applicable, Gahwah service and guest item offerings using refined language and correct terminology.
ECONOMY - Ensured standard pre-departure services, including children's activity pack distribution, self-introduction, heating meals on the ground (as applicable), and welcoming Etihad Guest members.
Played relevant videos, boarding/disembarkation music (when applicable) and ensured clear, timely, professional PAs.
PREMIUM - Supervised cabin crew to promote dining concepts, upsell F&B options by highlighting the selection, and use refined language and precise menu terminology throughout the service.
ECONOMY - Supervised cabin crew to use appropriate service language and menu terminology while offering the full selection of F&B products during service.
Supervised service flows, sequences, responsibilities, and handover procedures to ensure standards are followed.
PREMIUM - Supervised cabin crew to ensure timely product and service delivery following standards, including plating, tray setups, table layouts, and drink service.
ECONOMY - Supervised cabin crew to ensure timely product and service delivery as per standard, adhering to equipment care and cart setup guidelines.
Demonstrated in-depth knowledge of business products, services, beverages, Etihad Guest program, electrical equipment and cabin crew resources.
Ensured cabin crew complete pre-landing preparations, including clearing service equipment, assisting with seat setup, and returning guest belongings promptly.
Managed the team to ensure post-disembarkation duties, including collecting and stowing service items, are completed on time and to standard.
Followed Hospitality Essentials
Monitored all cabins during boarding to ensure cabin crew is in their designated position, offer a warm welcome, proactively assist guests, and managed stowage of cabin baggage.
Ensured cabin crew assists families, Etihad Guest members, VIPs, and guests requiring special care.
Managed ad-hoc situations and guest requests effectively.
Greeted Premium cabin guests and EYG (as applicable) by introducing self, welcoming them by name, and building rapport.

Ensured guest comfort is monitored by cabin crew throughout the flight by proactively offering amenities, assisting with onboard facilities such as IFE, Streaming, WI-FI & Connectivity, seat functions, and providing turn-down service in Premium including mattress setup (when applicable).
Ensured cabin crew interacts with guests authentically, showcasing genuine Emirati hospitality through a welcoming presence, positive attitude and warm and clear communication.
Ensured cabin crew responds to guests' needs and deliver personalized service promptly, including answering call bells and requests.
Ensured cabin crew actively recognizes and engages Etihad Guest members throughout the flight.
Ensured cabin crew engages in meaningful interactions beyond routine service.
Encouraged team to create a memorable moment for at least one guest and share their success stories post-flight.
Ensured cabin crew initiates conversations while serving meals or beverages, asking guests about their comfort or preferences, and offering refills or additional assistance.
Actively sought feedback from guests about their inflight experience promoting the completion of post flight NPS survey.

Measured guest satisfaction by proactively seeking feedback about their inflight experience in all cabins.
Ensured cabin crew carry out disembarkation process as defined in the Hospitality Manual, bidding guests a warm farewell.
Took a hands-on approach, regularly engaging with guests and crew in all cabins to monitor guest experience and cabin crew performance.
Followed Hospitality Essentials
Ensured cabins and lavatories are monitored and well-maintained.
Ensured galleys are organized for service, including station setups for Premium / cart setups for Economy.
Oversaw quality of food, beverages, equipment, and amenities, identifying and documenting any issues.
Ensured care of onboard products and equipment by overseeing item collection, storage, and waste management.
Ensured appropriate ambiance by managing lighting, temperature, IFE, connectivity, PA, and crew-to-seat messages following standards.

FIRST - Ensured cabin crew maintain regular cabin presence, offer food and beverages, refresh cabin, provide seat tidy-ups and clean lavatories/shower after each use to ensure guest comfort and satisfaction.

BUSINESS - Ensured cabin crew maintain regular cabin presence, monitor guest satisfaction, offer food and beverages, tidy seats, refresh the cabin every 15 minutes, and clean lavatories after each use.
ECONOMY - Ensured presence of cabin crew to monitor guest satisfaction, and complete cabin / lavatory refresh and hydration rounds every 30 minutes.

Resolved conflicts constructively to maintain team performance.
Showed strong decision-making skills in challenging situations.

Handled difficult guest conversations calmly, respectfully, and with flexibility.
Identified options quickly, monitored outcomes, and adapted as needed.

Respected cultural differences when interacting with others.
Acknowledged feedback professionally and is dedicated to continuous self-improvement.
Shared information, business knowledge and experience with the team.
Exhibited strong emotional intelligence by managing own emotions and supported the team, when required.
Proactively sought opportunities to develop and coach the team.
During debriefings, recognized cabin crew who went above and beyond when engaging with guests, managing onboard events, and shared their actions as best practices.

Actively recognized and encouraged cabin crew to exceed guest expectations by addressing issues through proactive escalation, consistent follow-up, and clear communication of resolution efforts with stakeholders, fostering a culture of exceptional service and teamwork.

Fairly and consistently evaluated the performance of cabin crew in alignment with company guidelines, recognizing achievements and identifying areas for improvement with a positive and constructive approach, promoting professional growth and maintaining high service standards.
Monitored cabin crew performance, provides feedback and recognition, and documents as needed.
Celebrated outstanding examples of guest interaction to reinforce the behavior.
